Snapshots.Name: error-compile
Problems: 本文テキスト 5 行目から相違: 期待 'Compiler Error Message: CS0029: 型 'string' を型 'int' に暗黙的に変換できません。' / 実際 'Compiler Error Message: CS0029: Cannot implicitly convert type 'string' to 'int''(期待 5 行 / 実際 5 行)
正解側にのみある行: 'Compiler Error Message: CS0029: 型 'string' を型 'int' に暗黙的に変換できません。'
実測側にのみある行: 'Compiler Error Message: CS0029: Cannot implicitly convert type 'string' to 'int''
Snapshots.Reason: the compiler's language: .NET Framework's ASP.NET ran csc.exe, whose messages are in Windows' display language (Japanese here: 'CS0029: 型 'string' を型 'int' に暗黙的に変換できません。') while the page's own text is the application's uiCulture (en-US); FrameworkOnCore compiles with Roslyn in the process, in the application's culture (English, as the rest of the page). The same error number, the same page, status and title.

Snapshots.Name: ajax-timer
Problems: HTML 5 行目から相違: 期待 '<script type="text/javascript">Sys.Application.add_init(function() {' / 実際 '</head>'(期待 96 行 / 実際 84 行)
正解側にのみある行: '<script type="text/javascript">Sys.Application.add_init(function() {' / '$create(Sys.UI._Timer, {"enabled":false,"interval":600,"uniqueID":"tm"}, null, null, $get("tm"));'
Snapshots.Reason: compilation debug="true": .NET Framework serves the debug ASP.NET AJAX scripts (MicrosoftAjax.debug.js: Sys.Debug.isDebug true), whose script loader leaves the startup scripts of each async postback in the head (Sys._ScriptLoaderTask._clearScript removes them only when not debugging); FrameworkOnCore's System.Web.Extensions has the release scripts only (its .debug.js are copies of the release ones), which remove them once run. The same deltas from the server (compared with a client of their own: every async postback's panel, hidden fields and the Timer's $create with enabled false after the third tick), the same ticks and page; only the executed script elements left in the document differ.
